description:
This process begins when a customer places an order through an online platform or over the phone.
The system automatically generates an order confirmation and sends it to the customer.
The warehouse team picks and packs the items, and a shipping label is generated.
The order is then handed over to a logistics provider for delivery.
Tracking information is sent to the customer.
The process continues as the shipment is monitored until it reaches the customer's address.
After successful delivery, the process ends, but customer feedback or returns may trigger further actions.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OnlineOrder" name="Online order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Return" name="Return"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Logistics" name="Logistics provider"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OnlineOrder"
                      name="Online order"
                      sourceRef="Task_PlaceOnlineOrder"
                      targetRef="Start_OnlineOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneOrder"
                      name="Phone order"
                      sourceRef="Task_PlacePhoneOrder"
                      targetRef="Start_PhoneOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation"
                      name="Order confirmation"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation"
                      targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShipmentHandover"
                      name="Shipment handover"
                      sourceRef="Task_HandoverShipment"
                      targetRef="Participant_Logistics"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TrackingInformation"
                      name="Tracking information"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendTracking"
                      targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerFeedback"
                      name="Customer feedback"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer"
                      targetRef="Start_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Return"
                      name="Return"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer"
                      targetRef="Start_Return"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Place order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Customer">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_CustomerOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SelectOrderChannel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOnlineOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlacePhoneOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeOrderChannels</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_CustomerOrderPlaced</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerOrder" name="Begin placing an order">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CustomerStartToChannel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SelectOrderChannel" name="Choose order channel" default="Flow_PhoneChannel"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOnlineOrder" name="Place order through online platform" messageRef="Message_OnlineOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnlineChannel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlacePhoneOrder" name="Place order over the phone" messageRef="Message_PhoneOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PhoneChannel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeOrderChannels" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderMergeToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerOrderPlaced" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderMergeToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerStartToChannel" sourceRef="Start_CustomerOrder" targetRef="Gateway_SelectOrderChannel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnlineChannel" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectOrderChannel" targetRef="Task_PlaceOnlineOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderChannel == 'online'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneChannel" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectOrderChannel" targetRef="Task_PlacePhoneOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOnlineOrder" targetRef="Gateway_MergeOrderChannels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge" sourceRef="Task_PlacePhoneOrder" targetRef="Gateway_MergeOrderChannels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderMergeToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeOrderChannels" targetRef="End_CustomerOrderPlaced"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_OrderFulfillment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouse" name="Warehouse team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PickPack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_OnlineOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_PhoneOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OrderChannelMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateShippingLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandoverShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTracking</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MonitorShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Delivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSubProcess_Feedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSubProcess_Return</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OnlineOrder" name="Online order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OnlineOrder" messageRef="Message_OnlineOrder"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PhoneOrder" messageRef="Message_PhoneOrder"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToGenerateConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToGenerateConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickPack" name="Pick and pack items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PickPackToLabel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PickPackToLabel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LabelToHandover</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandoverShipment" name="Hand over shipment to logistics provider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LabelToHandover</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HandoverToTracking</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HandoverToTracking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrackingToMonitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment until it reaches the customer address">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrackingToMonitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MonitorToDelivered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Delivered" name="Successful delivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MonitorToDelivered</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Feedback" name="Further action for customer feedback" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Feedback" name="Customer feedback received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Feedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackToAction</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_FurtherActionFeedback" name="Take further action">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackToAction</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackActionToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackAction" name="Further action completed">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackActionToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToAction" sourceRef="Start_Feedback" targetRef="Task_FurtherActionFeedback"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackActionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_FurtherActionFeedback" targetRef="End_FeedbackAction"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Return" name="Further action for returns" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Return" name="Return received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Return" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnToAction</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_FurtherActionReturn" name="Take further action">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnToAction</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnActionToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReturnAction" name="Further action completed">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnActionToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToAction" sourceRef="Start_Return" targetRef="Task_FurtherActionReturn"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnActionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_FurtherActionReturn" targetRef="End_ReturnAction"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge" sourceRef="Start_OnlineOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge" sourceRef="Start_PhoneOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToGenerateConfirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickPackToLabel" sourceRef="Task_PickPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToHandover" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Task_HandoverShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandoverToTracking" sourceRef="Task_HandoverShipment" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrackingToMonitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToDelivered" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="End_Delivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
